text: Thank you for providing that history. To better understand the progression of your gait and limb ataxia, could you describe how your balance issues have changed over time and if you experience any specific symptoms like slurred speech or numbness? Also, have you noticed any changes in your vision or memory?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain (including brainstem and cerebellum). Do you have any history of cancer, autoimmune disorders, or recent viral infections? Have you noticed any changes in your handwriting or difficulty swallowing?

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Vital Signs: Normothermic, Blood Pressure Within normal range, Heart Rate Within normal range, Respiratory Rate Within normal range. Neurological Examination: Ataxic gait noted, Right Upper Limb Strength 4/5, Evidence of ataxia. MRI Brain: Findings show Lesions consistent with Progressive Multifocal Encephalopathy (PML); T1/T2 images showing multifocal demyelinating lesions without gadolinium enhancement, indicative of PML.

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy in the setting of Crohn's disease.
